bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

user.description: Select a Holman garden light controller to set up. If your device isn't listed even though it appears in the Bluetooth dashboard, choose "Enter Bluetooth address manually…".

manual.description: Enter the controller's Bluetooth address exactly as shown in the Bluetooth dashboard (e.g. F3:61:AC:E8:BB:78).

error.invalid_address: That doesn't look like a valid Bluetooth address (expected format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX)

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Holman devices found in Bluetooth range
